The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: the dark part of the day.

notes: While 'noche' is the general word for night, it is also commonly used to mean 'evening' when discussing social plans or times before bed.
Use 'de la noche' when specifying the time after dark (e.g., 'ocho de la noche' for 8:00 PM), whereas 'de la tarde' is used for the late afternoon hours.

senses.definition: The dark part of the day that occurs between sunset and sunrise.

examples.text: La noche es muy tranquila en el pueblo.
examples.translation: The night is very quiet in the town.
examples.emotion: peaceful and observant, appreciating the silence

senses.definition: The early part of the night when people are still awake and active.

examples.text: Salimos a cenar por la noche.
examples.translation: We are going out to dinner in the evening.
examples.emotion: cheerful and looking forward to the plans
